name: harold-skills
description: Harold's personal collection of Claude Code skills, organized as plugins.

plugins.name: clinical-research
plugins.description: Clinical research workflow skills: study design, variable coding, statistical analysis, and paper drafting. For clinical medicine researchers conducting retrospective cohort studies.

plugins.name: excalidrawer
plugins.description: Code-first Excalidraw diagram generation. Per-type skills (flowchart / timeline / architecture / sequence) on a shared base clarify intent via AskUserQuestion, compose sugar elements, and call the excalidrawer MCP server to produce .excalidraw / .svg / .png outputs. Single-sourced from guohaonan-shy/excalidrawer; installing auto-registers the MCP server.

plugins.name: memex
plugins.description: Personal memory wiki built from your conversations. Pluggable connectors (lark / 飞书 today; wechat / slack later) pull raw chats + meeting transcripts, render them losslessly to markdown, then distill them into an obsidian-style wiki of people and things — persons / groups / topics (events live inline and in a dated log digest), written with #tag + Dataview fields + [[wikilinks]] + provenance anchors. Verb-oriented skills: ingest (fetch+render), recap (distill), comm-memory (dictation CRUD + lint), recall (fuzzy-query read front-door), reply-coach (draft high-friction replies). User data lives under ~/.memex/ — plugin dir is read-only references and prompts.

plugins.name: content-creator
plugins.description: Content creation toolkit for short-video / social-feed creators (Xiaohongshu, 视频号, YouTube). Currently ships thumbnail-gen — interactive HTML/CSS thumbnail generator with portrait-photo layout math, multi-platform spec presets (3:4 / 4:3 / 9:16 / 16:9), multi-ratio derivation, and Playwright screenshot rendering. Bundled Smiley Sans (得意黑) font. Roadmap: title-writer / post-writer / tag-gen / video-script.

plugins.name: happy-life
plugins.description: Personal lifestyle skills for small daily rituals, taste memory, and playful self-care workflows. Currently ships daily-coffee-oracle — a Markdown-profile based coffee recommendation skill that learns from casual coffee chat and generates refined ASCII coffee cards.

plugins.name: idea-loop
plugins.description: Closed loop from idea to shipped engineering, backed by a docs/ Obsidian vault as its knowledge base. Seven user-invoked skills, no state machine — a file's existence IS its status: a spec exists while the work is in flight, and is deleted once an ADR records why/how/result. grill runs a design-tree interview in frontier rounds (facts are the agent's job, decisions are the human's) until nothing is silently assumed; to-spec lands that conversation as a raw transcript plus one spec (problem, user stories, implementation + testing decisions, agreed seams); to-ticket slices a spec into tracer-bullet vertical cuts with blocking edges, each a temporary credential deleted on merge, and holds the design-freeze gate for UI work; implement turns one ticket into one commit in a fresh session, driving TDD at the seams the spec already agreed and never reopening the plan, then hands off to pr-open-review (push, open PR, round-1 three-axis review) and pr-fix-verify (one round of agreed fixes, then re-review) — Correctness / Standards / Spec run in parallel and never merged or reranked; dreaming reconciles every doc against origin/main — including CLAUDE.md — and proposes disposals the human approves before anything moves. Generalized out of a real project (Toeflair) — reads the current repo's own CLAUDE.md and lint/typecheck config rather than hardcoding either.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop design pipeline for product surfaces: one entry (design) takes a requirement through target-project truth loading, clarification, 2-3 independently generated gray-box wireframe candidates, and a single human selection gate, then routes into static UI design (design-ui, altitude-routed Surface/Module/Component) and, when warranted, verified motion (design-motion), closing with a port-fidelity gate (design-port). design-brief is the upstream skill that establishes a project's DESIGN.md (T1 identity floors / T2 case law / T3 bans) when one doesn't exist yet. Project-agnostic and self-contained: brand and token law is read at runtime from the target project's DESIGN.md, degrading to the plugin's vendored taste layer when absent. Ships a deterministic lint hook that fires on writes to design-preview/ and design-motion-preview/ HTML.

plugins.name: interview-coach
plugins.description: AI Engineer / AI Agent Engineer / Harness 方向的面试陪练。mock-interview 基于简历 + 目标方向扮演面试官,按四类问题框架(概括/选型/实现/延伸场景)深挖简历项目和领域知识点,全程不给反馈；interview-review 消费一场面试的转录(mock-interview 产物,或真实面试的录音转写),逐题做内容结构/表达/hook/技术准确性四维复盘,并把暴露出的知识漏洞讲透。两个 skill 共享同一份从真实面试教练转录里蒸馏出的四类问题框架和领域知识点清单。
